Counsel for the petitioner : Sri K. Govardhan Reddy
Counsel for respondent Nos.1 to 4 : Gp for Land Acquisition
Counsel for respondent Nos.5 & 6 : Sri S.S. Varma (Standing
 Counsel)
 Order

Heard Sri K. Govardhan Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondent Nos.1 to 4.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner's land admeasuring 99.120 sq.
meters in Sy.No.94/1 of Piler Village, Annamaiah District was acquired for the road over bridge by National Highway Authority at K.M.56/800.
Award SRS, J No.4/2022 dated 31.10.2022 was passed by the authorities fixing the market value at Rs.64,25,710/-.
The petitioner made a representation dated 09.07.2023 to different authorities including the District Collector, Annamayya District seeking enhancement of the compensation.
Since representation was not considered, the above writ petition is filed.

3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition would submit that if any person is aggrieved regarding the fixation of compensation, as per the award by the competent authority, the person shall file an appropriate application under Section 3(G)(5) of the National Highways Act,
1956 (for short 'the Act').
Learned Assistant Government Pleader did not dispute the representation made by the petitioner to the District Collector on 09.07.2023.
He would also submit that the limitation to make an application from the passing of the award is three years.

sentences.text: Thus, as seen from the material available on record, there is no dispute that the petitioner's land admeasuring 99.120 sq. maters is acquired vide Award No.4/2022 dated 31.10.2022 for construction of road over bridge at K.M.56/800 of Piler Village and Mandal, Annamaiah District.
The petitioner, instead of making an application under Section 3(G)(5) of the Act, made a representation dated 09.07.2023.
However, the acknowledgment filed along with the writ petition shows, that the representation made by the petitioner was received by the office of District Collector.
SRS, J 5.

Given the discussion supra, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the learned District Collector, Annamaiah District i.e., the 2nd respondent to treat the representation made by the petitioner on 09.07.2023 as the application made under Section 3(G)(5) of the Act and pass appropriate orders strictly as per law, as expeditiously as possible.
The 2nd respondent shall also issue notice to the petitioner enabling him to produce the material at the time of enquiry.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
___________________________ JUSTICE SUBBA REDDY SATTI Date: 08.05.2024
